name: Website / SaaS Demo
visual_style: Clean product-demo look built around the real website or app UI: crisp screens, device frames and brand-accurate colors.
camera: Smooth zooms and pans across UI regions, focused on one feature at a time.
lighting: Clean, even screen-friendly lighting with soft shadows under device frames.
motion: Cursor-led interactions, purposeful UI reveals and smooth screen-to-screen moves.
consistency: Same product UI, brand colors and fonts as the captured website in every scene.
negative_guidance: Any UI, dashboards, readable screens, documents, words, letters, logos or brand names (the real UI comes from the website screenshots).

video.typography: The product's own brand fonts (from the captured site); clean sans-serif fallback
video.palette: The product's brand colors on a clean light or dark UI background
video.transitions: Smooth zoom into UI regions, slides between screens, cursor-led moves
video.text_animation: Feature callouts, highlight boxes, cursor clicks and typing
video.sound: Soft clicks on cursor actions, typing for inputs, light whooshes between screens

image_style: Clean, text-free visuals in the brand's colors: abstract gradients and soft 3D shapes, people working with screens turned away or softly blurred, devices with blank glowing screens, workplace and lifestyle moments.
